title: the venv carries the dev extra
intention: Every box's ~/.cairn/venv carries pyproject's dev extra. An install-inspector check measures it, reds a venv without it while naming the missing modules, and its fix pass installs the editable checkout with [dev].
why: Measured 2026-11-12: on akienasus, ~/.cairn/venv had no pytest. akienasus_cc_0 installed the dev extra (pytest, wtree, starlette) by hand. A box that cannot import pytest cannot run `cairn test`, so it proves nothing.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: proofs must be runnable on every box to measure anything. Law 4: the akienasus hand install becomes the floor's physics.
how: RE-SHAPED 2026-11-12 under parent bdd0ed77930f (Akien: "i would say we need an install inspector and gate. then we can set up python, and once it's set up use that to detect what else with just a tool call"). As first cast, the probe lived in bootstrap.sh; Recovery's bootstrap now brings up python and the venv only, and every other install fact is an inspector check. So: ensure_dev_extra(dry_run) in the installer, shaped {id,status,detail} like every step. It reads [project.optional-dependencies].dev from pyproject.toml, strips the version specifiers, and asks the venv's python to import each name. With dry_run it only measures; otherwise it runs <venv>/bin/pip install --editable '<repo>[dev]' and measures again. It joins the inspector's CHECKS. Proved with a scratch venv whose python is a recording stub.

clauses.claim: over a venv missing a dev-extra module, ensure_dev_extra(dry_run=True) returns status offered, its detail names the missing module, and nothing is installed
ensure_dev_extra(dry_run=False) over the same venv invokes pip install --editable on '<repo>[dev]' through the venv's own pip
over a venv where every dev-extra module imports, it returns already_applied and invokes no pip

decisions.text: D1: ensure_dev_extra(dry_run=False, venv=None, repo=None) in the installer (at its post-ce1d61032eff address): it reads the dev extra from pyproject.toml with tomllib, strips specifiers, probes each import through the venv's python, and returns {id:'dev_extra', status, detail}. It registers in the install inspector's CHECKS (bdd0ed77930f D1).
D2: the proof drives ensure_dev_extra over a scratch venv whose python and pip are recording stubs, one tooth per clause (PROVES 1-3); nothing reaches the network.

measured.saw: akienasus ~/.cairn/venv had no pytest; the dev extra was installed by hand
measured.how: akienasus_cc_0's report, relayed by the orchestrator

measured.saw: bootstrap.sh line 282 runs pip install --editable on the repo with no extra
